LightningComponentBundle.description: Lets the donor add a percentage of the donation to cover transaction fees, and shows the fee formatted like the FinDock Pay button.

property.name: amountOneTime
property.label: Amount: One-Time
property.description: The one-time donation amount, for example the Amount and Frequency one-time output.

property.name: amountRecurring
property.label: Amount: Recurring
property.description: The recurring donation amount, for example the Amount and Frequency recurring output.

property.name: currencyIsoCode
property.label: Currency ISO Code
property.description: The currency the Pay button charges in. Leave empty to use the org currency.

property.name: percentage
property.label: Percentage
property.description: Percentage of the donation the donor can add, for example 2.9.

property.name: label
property.label: Checkbox Label
property.description: Optional. Use {0} for the fee. Leave empty for "Cover fees for this donation (+{0})".

property.name: value
property.label: Selected
property.description: True when the donor selects the checkbox.

property.name: feeAmount
property.label: Fee Amount
property.description: The fee added to the donation: the calculated fee when selected, otherwise 0. Map it to the Pay button's Transaction Fee Amount and add it to the charged amounts.
